rca_of_the_issue: Root cause (already fixed by main agent): FastAPI applies Pydantic response_model serialization on GET /api/orders. OrderWithMotorcycle did not declare kentekenbewijs_url, payment_instructions, supplier_info, motorcycle_license_plate fields. With model_config extra='ignore' (default strip), Pydantic silently removed those fields from the outbound payload even though MongoDB had the data. Admin's internal tooling (curl/network tab) may have shown the data existed in DB but the API layer stripped them. Ellen's frontend /pakbon/:id therefore received undefined for these props and rendered nothing. Fix: added Optional fields with defaults to OrderWithMotorcycle. Verified: pakbon + admin now both receive the fields and the UI renders them.
